landing.tagline: Book your slot. Skip the queue. Track your payment.
landing.hero.title: No more waiting all day at the procurement centre
landing.hero.text: Book a time slot to sell your crop, watch your turn live on your phone, and get an SMS at every step until the money reaches you.
landing.demo.label: Your token
landing.demo.status: Your turn is near. Please come to the centre.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.step1.title: Register with your mobile
landing.how.step1.text: Log in with an OTP sent by SMS. No password to remember.
landing.how.step2.title: Book a time slot
landing.how.step2.text: Choose your centre, date, time and crop. You get a token number.
landing.how.step3.title: Come at your time
landing.how.step3.text: See your queue position and waiting time live. We send an SMS when your turn is near.
landing.how.step4.title: Get paid
landing.how.step4.text: Your crop is weighed and checked, and you can track the payment until it is credited.
